name: KeibiDrop
description: Your Unraid box becomes the always-on peer of an encrypted peer-to-peer folder mount. Your computer mounts the shared folder with the KeibiDrop app and reads it on demand: only the bytes you touch move, end to end encrypted (hybrid post-quantum key exchange). No account, no cloud. The serving side needs no FUSE. AGPL-3.0. After the first start, open the container log: it prints this box's code and the three pairing steps.

paths.name: Shared folder
paths.description: The folder this box serves. Set the mode to read only to let the peer read and change nothing.

paths.name: Identity and contacts
paths.description: Holds this box's private identity key. Keep it out of shared backups.

variables.name: Peer code
variables.description: Your computer's 86-character code: press Copy my code in the KeibiDrop app with Local mode off. Leave empty to pair later from the container console with: kd add-contact laptop code

variables.name: Peer name
variables.description: Contact name for the peer code.

variables.name: Read only share
variables.description: true refuses every change the peer sends.

variables.name: Inbound port
variables.description: TCP port peers dial (26000 to 27000). Change only if another KeibiDrop peer on this box uses it.

variables.name: Outbound port
variables.description: TCP port this box dials from.

variables.name: Strict mode
variables.description: true never falls back to the bridge; the connection fails when no direct path exists.
